questions.answer: Go for 6 ects courses if possible. Not much difference between 3 and 6 ects courses in terms of academic requirements.

questions.answer: The academic difficulty of the courses were more or less the same as UCPH, however, the credits offered for each course were significantly lower.

questions.question: How did the style of teaching at your host institution compare with that of UCPH? *
questions.answer: The teaching style were much more 'traditional' than UCPH with less active participation.
